# Autoliv Appoints Joachim Rosenberg to its Board of Directors


Tue, Nov 10, 2026 06:21 CET[Report this content](https://news.cision.com/_editorial/Contact?url=https%3a%2f%2fnews.cision.com%2fautoliv%2fr%2fautoliv-appoints-joachim-rosenberg-to-its-board-of-directors%2cc4422222)


***(Boston, USA, November 10, 2026)*** **– Autoliv, Inc.** **(NYSE: ALV and SSE: ALIVsdb), the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems, announces that it has added a new independent member to its Board of Directors effective today.**


On November 10, 2026, Autoliv announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Mr. Joachim Rosenberg as an independent director to the Autoliv Board of Directors. With the addition of Mr. Rosenberg, Autoliv has expanded its Board size from nine to ten directors


Mr. Rosenberg most recently served as Executive Vice President, Volvo Group Strategic Initiatives and President, Volvo Energy from January 2023 to September 2024. This was part of a twenty-year career with Volvo Group companies, including senior leadership roles also across major, related joint ventures and alliances. Leadership roles within the Volvo Group included EVP, Volvo Group; Chairman of UD Trucks; EVP, Group Truck Sales and President, Volvo Group Asia Truck Operations.


Mr. Rosenberg previously spent eight years at McKinsey & Company, Inc. in Sweden and the US, working with industrial and consumer goods blue chip companies with a special focus on the automotive sector and major performance improvement programs. Mr. Rosenberg joined the Board of Directors of


Johnson Matthey Plc


, in July 2026 and also serves on its Audit, Nomination, and Remuneration Committees. Mr. Rosenberg also serves, and has served, on the boards of directors of several privately held European companies.


“I am pleased that Joachim joins the Autoliv Board of Directors, bringing a wealth of experience in Asian operations, strategic initiatives management, and deep knowledge of global automotive operations,


”


said Jan Carlson, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Autoliv, Inc. “Joachim’s experience is a welcome addition to the Autoliv Board.”


Mr. Rosenberg is appointed for a term expiring at the 2027 Annual General Meeting of Stockholders at which time the Board is expected to return to nine members with the retirement of Mr. Leif Johansson.

*About Autoliv*


*Autoliv, Inc. (NYSE: ALV; Nasdaq Stockholm: ALIV.sdb) is the worldwide leader in automotive safety systems. Through our group companies, we develop, manufacture and market protective systems, such as airbags, seatbelts, and steering wheels for all major automotive manufacturers in the world, as well as mobility safety solutions, such as commercial vehicles and electrical safety solutions. At Autoliv, we challenge and re-define the standards of mobility safety to sustainably deliver leading solutions. In 2025, our products saved approximately 40,000 lives and reduced around 600,000 injuries.*


*We have operations in 25 countries, and we drive innovation, research, and development at our 13 technical centers. Our 64,000 employees are passionate about our vision of Saving More Lives and quality is at the heart of everything we do. Sales in 2025 amounted to $10.8 billion. For more information go to*[www.autoliv.com](http://www.autoliv.com/) *.*
